nom: The Ordinary Hyaluronic Acid 2% + B5 Hydrating Serum with Ceramides

segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin frequently report improved hydration and reduced flaking or tight patches with regular use, though a distinct subset says the serum leaves their dry skin tighter, drier and pilling.
segments.sensitive: Reviewers with sensitive skin are split: several say it is the only hyaluronic acid that does not irritate them and appreciate the fragrance-free formula, while at least one report describes burning, redness and stinging on sensitive skin.
segments.mature: Reviewers who describe their skin as mature or older report softer, plumper skin and softened fine lines over weeks of use, though one mature-skin reviewer saw no visible change after a few uses.
segments.combination: One reviewer with combination skin, also managing cystic acne, reports the serum absorbs quickly and helps lock in moisture without issue.
segments.oily: One reviewer with oily skin reports the serum hydrates without feeling too sticky.

concerns.aging: Reviewers focused on aging report softer skin, reduced fine lines (including around the mouth and smile lines) and a brighter, more youthful look after weeks to months of use; one mature-skin reviewer reports no noticeable change yet.
concerns.dehydration: Most reviewers addressing dehydration report significant relief, especially in winter or with dry patches on the nose, cheeks and between eyebrows; however, a distinct minority report the opposite effect, describing worsened dryness, tightness and flaking, particularly when applied to dry rather than damp skin.
concerns.redness: Reports are mixed and few: one reviewer's sensitive-skin relative developed redness and stinging after use, while another says it is the only hyaluronic acid that does not irritate their sensitive skin.
concerns.barrier: One reviewer with combination skin and cystic acne credits it with helping lock in moisture and support the skin barrier; another reports burns and worsened skin after use.
concerns.spots: One reviewer reports dark spots gradually lightened with use; this is the only mention of spots.
concerns.blemishes: Several reviewers report clearer skin and fewer or no new breakouts, including with acne treatments and cystic acne; however, multiple reviewers report new breakouts starting after one to two weeks of use, with no other routine changes.
concerns.oiliness: One reviewer with oily skin reports the product hydrates without excess grease or clogging pores; no reports of increased oiliness.

aspects.libelle: Works best applied to damp skin
Tacky or sticky feel when misused

extraits.titre: I will never understand this product.
extraits.texte: For the life of me I will never be able to understand how a hyaluronic acid serum with ceramides is drying, but it is. this serum leaves my skin dry, tight and uncomfortable and causes the most atrocious pilling. Forget layering it with other products or makeup, this serum sabotages everything it touches. I've re purchased this so many times and it's the same result. Exfoliated and bare skinned or mixed with another serum or moisturizer, doesn't matter. Here come the gross little peeling pills with an awful drying sensation. for whatever reason it won't work with my skin, so beware, you may be the same way. doesn't matter how cheap it is if it's still a complete waste of money.
I bought because I was struggling with dry skin and after using this product for a week, my skin has gotten progressively worse. Its super red and I now have chemical burns everywhere. DO NOT BUY!

I will always love the ordinarys dropper packaging and feel as if their products last for a while! I will never have a problem repurchasing them because they are always worth it. I let my sister try it (she has sensetive skin) and after rubbing it in it burned her skin and caused her to experience a bit of redness and stinging.

I have dry skin, and its been hard finding a product that actually keeps my face FEELING hydrated. My nose has always felt dry and slightly itchy, and my cheeks had closed comedones everywhere! I consulted with one of the Ulta employees (who was SO helpful), and they told me to add some Hyaluronic into my routine for that extra hydration. While I was browsing, another employee came and told me this product was amazing! The price tag seemed good too, and I bought it. My nose is no longer feeling dry, and my comedones finally went away! If you have dryness on your skin, PLEASE get this, its so affordable and feels AMAZING! The bottle looks small, but you're only supposed to use a bit. Its been two weeks and mine hasn't budged! ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️

Cursed with ever-changing combination skin in addition to 2 types of cystic acne, my skin soaks this up nearly instantly and really helps lock in moisture to help my skin barrier. It makes great strides in preventing painful cystic acne and is an absolute staple to my entire routine. When my routine needs to run lean, this makes the cut every time. I hope this never gets discontinued.
I have sensitive skin and this is the only hyaluronic acid that does not irritate my skin. Works wonders.

extraits.titre: Likely it's only been a couple of weeks
extraits.texte: Love the simplicity smoothness and texture of my face giving the fact I have mature skin
